RiteCare Clinic
services.desc: The treatment of Childhood Language Disorders a major undertaking of the Guthrie Scottish Rite Charitable and Educational Foundation. In an effort to improve our ability to reach more children, the Guthrie Foundation has entered into a partnership with Oklahoma State University. Our Scottish Rite Clinic is now located on the campus of Oklahoma State University in Stillwater as part of their Speech-Language-Hearing Clinic, which serves children with communication disorders from across the region. Communication Disorders are the most common problem for children affecting more than all other disorders combined. The Scottish Rite is the leading private benefactor for Childhood Language

blurb: On April 22, 1889, Harper Samuel Cunningham, 33°, made the Run of the Unassigned Lands which opened up for settlement what is now the five counties of central Oklahoma. He came to practice law in the newly opened Territory. And he came to establish the Ancient and Accepted Scottish Rite of Freemasonry in what would soon become Oklahoma.
